title: ALIS territory budget
description: Ceilings frozen BEFORE a territory is implemented, so the first realization cannot redefine success once its cost is known. Source and canonical ceilings are hard. Unreal-side ceilings are provisional: they may be re-frozen from Slice 3/4 measurements, but a breach before that is a stop-and-decide, never a silent new baseline.

validation_profile_id.description: Identity the Slice 3 validation profile MUST take. It does not exist yet because its required per-leg expectations (expected_features, incremental_bounds, map_package, and a synthetic twin) are only knowable after the first territory compile; inventing them would assert untested facts.

kind.description: hard = frozen for the milestone; provisional = re-freezable from Slice 3/4 measurements, breach is a stop-and-decide.
